_comment: Mid-session state after reading examples/sample_strategy.md. Verdicts are the agent's judgements; each carries the evidence that produced it. Run: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m graphify assess examples/session_state.json

evidence.test:contains_a_bet: There is one bet - that customers will recognise the value of reliability - but it is stated as an obligation on the customer rather than a claim about their behaviour.
evidence.test:claims_are_falsifiable: The vision statement would remain true if any competitor's name were substituted for Northwind's.
evidence.test:aspiration_is_contestable: Winning is expressed as a revenue figure, a margin and an NPS score. No market position is named that a competitor could deny them.
evidence.test:wtp_exists: Customers and offering are named, but the arena is 'all shippers who need reliable freight management' plus an $84B TAM.
evidence.test:wtp_has_exclusions: No customers, segments, geographies or channels are excluded anywhere in the document.
evidence.test:wtp_dimensions_covered: Brokers and direct are both mentioned as routes to market, but neither is presented as a choice and the brokers' own interests are absent.
evidence.test:segments_behavioural: Segments are enterprise, mid-market and SMB - size bands, with the same offer aimed at each.
evidence.test:customer_action_named: No specific customer behaviour is named, and price appears only as a company-level margin target.
evidence.test:pttc_exists: No promise is stated in customer-facing terms; the closest is 'reliability', undefined.
evidence.test:customer_insight_present: Nothing in the document speaks to why these shippers choose as they do. Needs to be asked rather than inferred.
evidence.test:htw_exists: A way of winning is gestured at - service quality plus competitive price - but not as a reason a customer would choose them.
evidence.test:htw_single_logic: Six strategic priorities joined by nothing; any one could be removed without affecting the others.
evidence.test:htw_resolves_to_advantage_type: Claims best service quality and most competitive price simultaneously, with no mechanism for either and no trade-off acknowledged.
evidence.test:relative_claim_named: 'Take share from incumbents' - no incumbent is named, and there is no account of what shippers do today.
evidence.test:imitation_barrier_exists: The stated barrier is a 40-year reputation described as unassailable, which is not something a rival would have to give anything up to erode.
evidence.test:advantage_renewal_logic: Advantage is framed as a permanent moat; no account of how it could decay or how it gets re-earned.
evidence.test:capabilities_traced_to_htw: Capabilities are four single words - digital, data, talent, customer focus - none traced to a step in any winning logic.
evidence.test:capability_gaps_named: No gaps identified, though the Southeast expansion and the portal both imply capabilities not yet demonstrated.
evidence.test:systems_change_named: Nothing changes in measures, budgets or routines; the review is the annual planning offsite.
evidence.test:leading_indicators_exist: All three measures are financial or share-based, reviewed annually.
evidence.test:resource_shift_matches_choices: Funded from unspecified operating efficiencies; nothing is being stopped.
evidence.test:must_be_trues_listed: No assumptions are stated anywhere in the document.
evidence.test:barriers_identified: No condition is identified as doubtful; everything is asserted with equal confidence.
evidence.test:no_misplaced_shoulds: 'Customers should recognise the value of our reliability' - the central behavioural assumption is phrased as an obligation.
evidence.test:sacrifice_is_visible: Six priorities, all additive. Nothing is given up and no constituency appears to have traded anything away.
evidence.test:strategy_is_sayable: Not yet observed - ask the user to state it without the document.
